description: Company Watch (Career) configuration. Company Watch watches the organisations already recorded in Mukund's historical application/CV evidence against their public structured ATS/career endpoints, and hands eligible findings to the existing Career Ops tracker writer. It never submits applications, never contacts companies/recruiters, never holds application state, and never writes a tracker outside career-ops/tracker_writer.py.

probe.verify_derived_urls_note: A URL constructed from a documented vendor pattern is not vendor evidence; it is fetched once and only accepted if it resolves with HTTP 200.

eligibility.owner_filters_source: career-ops install portals.yml (UK lane only; other regions have no lane config yet)
eligibility.title_matching: standalone-token (word boundary) so 'Intern' cannot match 'Internal Audit'
eligibility.location_matching: standalone-token against location_filter.allow/always_allow with location_filter.block applied
eligibility.unknown_posted_date: not eligible (a finding with no verifiable posting date cannot satisfy the owner's max_posting_age_days rule)

workbook.purpose: monthly Company Watch operational record only; never application state, never fed back into Career Ops dedupe

regional_lane_dependency.note: Regional scan/schedule lanes (Dubai/Japan/Singapore portals.yml lanes) are owned by agent-regional-job-search-agents-and-schedulers-2026-09-23. Company Watch records a non-UK finding's region_route but does not hand it off unless that region is explicitly requested.
